reviewMethod: Each of the 1455 assigned entries was read individually as Japanese headword, reading and Korean gloss, in source-order batches. Representative Korean meanings were judged semantically, not approved by formatting or automatic word matching. Uncertain readings, homonyms and corrupted headwords were checked in the original JMdict or named primary publisher dictionaries. Legacy IDs and order preserved. Proposed concise meaning changes include both mistranslation corrections and representative-sense improvements; they are not all assertions of factual errors.
